facts.text: The hotel sits on South Tyrol's Alpe di Siusi, a high-altitude plateau in the Dolomites.
facts.excerpt: Our location on South Tyrol's Alpe di Siusi one of Europe's largest, most beautiful high-altitude plateaus

facts.text: The hotel is cradled by the sheer cliffs of a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site in northern Italy.
facts.excerpt: cradled by the sheer cliffs of a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site in northern Italy

facts.text: The hotel is set at an altitude of 1,800 metres.
facts.excerpt: Set at an altitude of 1,800 metres, the property offers panoramic views of mountain peaks and alpine meadows.

facts.text: The hotel offers direct ski-in ski-out access, within the Dolomiti Superski region of Val Gardena.
facts.excerpt: offers direct ski-in ski-out access from our slopeside resort in Alpe di Siusi, within the Dolomiti Superski region of Val Gardena

facts.text: The exterior is clad with quartzite and wood, a nod to the mineral-rich terrain.
facts.excerpt: The exterior is clad with quartzite and wood a nod to the mineral-rich terrain.

facts.text: Guests enter through an entryway designed to resemble a rock crevice.
facts.excerpt: You pass through an entryway designed to resemble a rock crevice

facts.text: Rooms combine soft colours with quality furnishings finessed by South Tyrol's traditional artisans.
facts.excerpt: combine soft colours with quality furnishings finessed by South Tyrol's traditional artisans

facts.text: The Mountain Suite has a clean-burning bio-ethanol fireplace and a private infrared sauna.
facts.excerpt: complete with clean-burning bio-ethanol fireplace and a private infrared sauna

facts.text: The Dolomites Chalet Suite is a two-bedroom suite with a curved layout.
facts.excerpt: A two-bedroom suite with a curved layout, including a living area, guest toilet, and two ensuite bedrooms.

facts.text: The hotel completed a refurbishment of its Chalet Suites in summer.
facts.excerpt: This summer we completed the refurbishment of our Chalet Suites

facts.text: Access to the COMO Shambhala wellness facilities, including indoor and outdoor thermal pools, is complimentary during a stay.
facts.excerpt: including fitness centre, sauna, steam room, indoor and outdoor thermal pools

facts.text: The spa offers a South Tyrol-inspired hay bath.
facts.excerpt: as well as specialist massage for sports, and South Tyrol-inspired hay bath

facts.text: The spa has a Finnish and bio-herb sauna with two Kneipp basins.
facts.excerpt: A Finnish and bio-herb sauna with two Kneipp basins

facts.text: The spa has a relaxation room with single and double waterbeds.
facts.excerpt: One room with single and double waterbeds, and another with sofa and beds from which to enjoy the mountain panorama.

facts.text: The hotel offers daily yoga, Pilates and guided meditation sessions suitable for all levels.
facts.excerpt: offers daily yoga, Pilates, and guided meditation sessions, suitable for all levels

facts.text: A guided Sellaronda ski tour across four mountain passes is offered as a group tour in the complimentary weekly programme.
facts.excerpt: Join a guided group tour offered as part of our complimentary weekly programme (no fixed days)

facts.text: The guided mindful hike leads through the alpine trails of the Alpe di Siusi to Bullaccia Hill.
facts.excerpt: a peaceful guided hike through the alpine trails of the Alpe di Siusi to Bullaccia Hill

facts.text: Snow Power Biking is an e-bike tour on the Alpe di Siusi's snowy trails on spiked winter tyres.
facts.excerpt: Embark on an adventurous e-bike tour across the stunning Alpe di Siusi, tackling snowy trails on spiked winter tyres.

facts.text: The Play by COMO kids club is for children aged 4 to 12.
facts.excerpt: a dedicated Play by COMO kids-club for children aged 4–12

facts.text: The resort has three restaurants and a bar.
facts.excerpt: The resort features three restaurants and a bar, offering elegant mountain dining and relaxed après-ski atmospheres, all with panoramic alpine views.

facts.text: Alpina Chalet Grill and Bar can be accessed easily from the slopes.
facts.excerpt: can be accessed easily from the slopes if you want to stop off for a drink or lunch with friends

facts.text: The hotel was awarded One MICHELIN Key in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italy, its third consecutive year of recognition.
facts.excerpt: has been awarded One MICHELIN Key in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Italy hotel selection, marking its third consecutive year of recognition since 2024

facts.text: The hotel will close for a seasonal break after October 25th and reopen on December 4th for the winter season.
facts.excerpt: COMO Alpina Dolomites will remain open until October 25th before closing for a seasonal break. We look forward to welcoming you back on December 4th for the winter season in the Dolomites.

facts.text: The hotel operates seasonally, in winter from December to March and in summer and autumn from June to October.
facts.excerpt: welcoming guests during the winter season from December to March and the summer and autumn season from June to October

facts.text: Access by private car on Alpe di Siusi is not allowed from 9am to 5pm without a transit permit.
facts.excerpt: Please note that access by private car on Alpe di Siusi is not allowed from 9.00am to 5.00pm without a transit permit.

facts.text: The property is near the mountain station of the Siusi-Alpe di Siusi cableway.
facts.excerpt: The property is located near the mountain station of the Siusi-Alpe di Siusi cableway.

facts.text: An underground walkway connects the main building with a wood-clad rotunda.
facts.excerpt: An underground walkway connects the main building with a wood-clad rotunda

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the towering Sassolungo peak.
facts.excerpt: Everything overlooks the towering Sassolungo and Sassa Piatto peaks.

facts.text: Afternoon pastries, cakes and savoury snacks are served complimentary in the lobby lounge.
facts.excerpt: Afternoon pâtisserie, cakes and savoury snacks served in the lobby lounge

facts.text: COMO acquired a 90 percent share in the hotel in 2023 and the remaining 10 percent in December 2023.
facts.excerpt: ran it until 2023, when Singapore-based company COMO acquired a 90 percent share in the hotel. In December 2023, they bought the remaining 10 percent.
